gloss: facial expression; look on one's face

definitions.gloss: facial expression; look on one's face; countenance
definitions.explanation: The overall appearance or expression of someone's face, often reflecting their mood, character, or emotional state.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧{顔|かお}つき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has a scary look on his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧な{顔|かお}つき⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: She began to speak with a serious expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔|かお}つき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{楽|たの}しんでいる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: You can tell right away whether the children are having fun by the looks on their faces.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face) and つき (appearance, way of being attached). The suffix つき indicates the way something looks or the manner in which it appears.

USAGE:
Often used with adjectives or descriptive phrases to characterize how someone's face looks: {優|やさ}しい{顔|かお}つき (a kind-looking face), ⟦{険|けわ}しい→険しい：08154_kewashii⟧{顔|かお}つき (a stern expression). Commonly appears with the pattern 〜{顔|かお}つき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have a ... expression).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{険|けわ}しい→険しい：08154_kewashii⟧{顔|かお}つき — stern/grim expression
- {優|やさ}しい{顔|かお}つき — gentle/kind expression
- ⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧な{顔|かお}つき — serious expression
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧な{顔|かお}つき — anxious expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ — facial expression; more about momentary emotional expression
- ⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧ — facial features; refers to the physical structure of the face rather than expression
- {面持|おもも}ち — expression, look; literary/formal synonym
